subject: GCP listing: multi-SKU onboarding & procurement kickoff
messages:
From: Alex Monroe <alex@cloudlens.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: CloudLens / Redwood — multi-SKU GCP listing questions and procurement baseline

Hi Karthik and Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week — CloudLens leadership liked the performance benchmarks on long-form generation. We are starting the internal process to get Redwood listed on the GCP Marketplace and, importantly, to enable a multi-SKU offering (hosted API + Dedicated plan + Private deployment option).

Two asks to get us moving:
- Can you confirm the procurement checklist for multi-product listings (commercial SKUs, separate billing/entitlement for Dedicated)?
- Do you have a standard SOW + pricing matrix we can drop into our procurement system?
- We also need a SOC 2 attestation and any audit evidence you provide to partners.

I attached our standard procurement questionnaire to speed things up. Goal from CloudLens: get listing + co-sell ready by mid-June. Is that timeline reasonable from your side?

Appreciate a quick note on next steps and a proposed kickoff time.

Thanks,
Alex Monroe
Director, Commercial Partnerships
CloudLens Inc.

Attachments: CloudLens_Procurement_Questionnaire.pdf (pdf, 210KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Monroe <alex@cloudlens.io>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 17:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudLens / Redwood — multi-SKU GCP listing questions and procurement baseline

Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the questionnaire. We're excited to partner on this. Short answers up front: yes, we support multi-SKU listings on GCP (each SKU maps to an entitlement), and we can provide an SOW + pricing matrix and SOC 2 Type II report.

Proposed next steps (quick):
1) Kickoff call to align on SKUs, billing model, and go-live checklist.
2) Redwood to share draft SOW + SKU/pricing table and SOC 2 PDF.
3) CloudLens to return completed procurement questionnaire and target go-live date.

Availability for a 60-minute kickoff call next week (PT):
- Mon 4/19 09:00–11:00
- Tue 4/20 10:00–12:00
- Thu 4/22 09:00–10:30

If none of those work, propose alternatives and we will accommodate. I'll loop in Lauren for billing entitlements and Marissa for GCP marketplace steps (partner enablement & listing ops).

— Kar
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Lead, Marketplace GTM
Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0146

Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: CloudLens GCP listing — prep and doc requests (action items)

Team — summarizing action items before the external kickoff so we have clean artifacts ready. CloudLens wants multi-SKU (Hosted API; Dedicated reserved capacity; Private deployment). Target go-live requested: mid-June (6/15). We should assume a 6–8 week enablement window.

Please action:
- Lauren: confirm entitlement mapping per SKU (billing codes and whether Dedicated maps to a separate contract). Need initial pricing bands by 4/19.
- Marissa: prepare marketplace onboarding checklist + partner enablement owner list (GCP contact). Also prep copy of our SOC2 Type II and redaction guidance.
- Camila: draft the SOW template for multi-SKU listing (include deployment model options, SLAs, and support tiers). Add standard addendum for private deployments.

I'll propose the 4/22 09:00 kickoff to Alex and get calendar invite out. Keep replies short — this is time-sensitive.

Thanks — K
From: Alex Monroe <alex@cloudlens.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudLens Procurement <procurement@cloudlens.io>, GCP Partner Enablement <gcp-partners@google.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 11:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CloudLens / Redwood — multi-SKU GCP listing questions and procurement baseline

Karthik — thanks, and appreciate the internal notes. Attached is the completed procurement form (we filled the details you requested). A couple of clarifications from our procurement team:
- For Dedicated SKU, procurement will require a separate contract and a 12-month commitment term. Is that supported?
- For Private deployment we need a KMS/HSM integration note in the SOW and a data retention policy statement.

We can do Thu 4/22 09:00 PT for the kickoff. Please send a calendar invite. Also looping in our partner enablement contact at GCP (gcp-partners@google.com) — they will help with listing requirements on their side.

Attached: CloudLens_Procurement_Form_filled.pdf

Best,
Alex
Director, Commercial Partnerships
CloudLens Inc.
